children: Moleculin Biotech regained compliance with Nasdaq’s minimum bid price requirement, but must meet continued listing rules and undergo monitoring.
Nasdaq notified Moleculin Biotech on November 24, 2026, that it had regained compliance with the $1.00 minimum bid price rule.
The company must maintain compliance with all Nasdaq listing rules through March 15, 2027.
Nasdaq will monitor the company’s bid-price compliance from March 16 through November 24, 2027.
A bid-price violation during the monitoring period could prompt a delisting determination without a cure period; the company may appeal.
Moleculin Biotech furnished a corporate presentation for its website as Exhibit 99.1.
